instruction.text: Match the reflexive pronouns with the personal pronouns they refer to.

hint.text:
Reflexive pronouns are words that refer back to the person or thing doing the action.

For example:
Keith enjoyed himself.
→ himself = reflexive pronoun
hint.sound: Reflexive pronouns are words that refer back to the person or thing doing the action. For example: Keith enjoyed himself. himself is a reflexive pronoun because it refers back to Keith.
